# 74S133 - 13-input positive NAND gate

Package DIP-16 · family 74S · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74S133.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74S133.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 27 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74S133 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74S133.png) | ![74S133 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74S133.png) | ![74S133 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74S133.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | Y = NOT(A AND B AND C AND D AND E AND F AND G AND H AND I AND J AND K AND L AND M) | 13-input NAND: Y is low only when all thirteen inputs are high. |

## Notes

Switching figures are the shared row for 'S30 and 'S133.
